requirements.quote: When a new subscription is established, the last retained message, if any, on each matching topic name MUST be sent to the subscriber.
requirements.condition: When a new Subscription is established and a matching Topic Name has a retained message
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must send the last retained message for each matching Topic Name to the subscriber.
requirements.why_checkable: Retained messages can be prepared on multiple matching topics before creating the Subscription, then deliveries observed.

requirements.quote: If the Server receives a QoS 0 message with the RETAIN flag set to 1 it MUST discard any message previously retained for that topic.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a QoS 0 PUBLISH with RETAIN set to 1 and a message is already retained for that Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must discard the previously retained message for that topic.
requirements.why_checkable: A prior retained value can be installed and its removal or replacement observed after the new PUBLISH.

requirements.quote: It SHOULD store the new QoS 0 message as the new retained message for that topic, but MAY choose to discard it at any time - if this happens there will be no retained message for that topic.
requirements.condition: After receiving a nonempty QoS 0 PUBLISH with RETAIN set to 1
requirements.required_behavior: The Server should store the new QoS 0 message as the retained message for that topic.
requirements.why_checkable: A later Subscription can reveal whether the new QoS 0 message was retained.

requirements.quote: It SHOULD store the new QoS 0 message as the new retained message for that topic, but MAY choose to discard it at any time - if this happens there will be no retained message for that topic.
requirements.condition: If the Server chooses to discard that newly retained QoS 0 message
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to discard it at any time, after which the topic must have no retained message.
requirements.why_checkable: After optional discard, a new matching Subscription can verify that no retained message is delivered.

requirements.quote: When sending a PUBLISH Packet to a Client the Server MUST set the RETAIN flag to 1 if a message is sent as a result of a new subscription being made by a Client.
requirements.condition: When the Server sends a retained message because a Client made a new Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must set RETAIN to 1 in the outgoing PUBLISH.
requirements.why_checkable: A new Subscription can trigger retained delivery and the outgoing PUBLISH RETAIN bit can be decoded.

requirements.quote: It MUST set the RETAIN flag to 0 when a PUBLISH Packet is sent to a Client because it matches an established subscription regardless of how the flag was set in the message it received.
requirements.condition: When the Server forwards PUBLISH because it matches an already established Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must set RETAIN to 0 in the outgoing PUBLISH regardless of the incoming RETAIN value.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not copy an incoming RETAIN=1 value into this established-Subscription delivery.
requirements.why_checkable: Matching publications can be sent with each incoming RETAIN value and the forwarded flag compared.

requirements.quote: A PUBLISH Packet with a RETAIN flag set to 1 and a payload containing zero bytes will be processed as normal by the Server and sent to Clients with a subscription matching the topic name.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives PUBLISH with RETAIN=1 and a zero-byte payload
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must process the PUBLISH through the normal publication path.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-byte retained PUBLISH can be injected and normal publication processing observed.

requirements.quote: A PUBLISH Packet with a RETAIN flag set to 1 and a payload containing zero bytes will be processed as normal by the Server and sent to Clients with a subscription matching the topic name.
requirements.condition: When RETAIN=1 PUBLISH with a zero-byte payload matches existing Client Subscriptions
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must send the PUBLISH to those matching Clients.
requirements.why_checkable: Matching subscribers can be connected and delivery of the zero-byte publication observed.

requirements.quote: Additionally any existing retained message with the same topic name MUST be removed and any future subscribers for the topic will not receive a retained message.
requirements.condition: When RETAIN=1 PUBLISH has a zero-byte payload and a retained message exists for the same Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must remove that existing retained message.
requirements.why_checkable: A retained message can be installed, cleared with a zero-byte retained PUBLISH, and storage then inspected.

requirements.quote: Additionally any existing retained message with the same topic name MUST be removed and any future subscribers for the topic will not receive a retained message.
requirements.condition: After a zero-byte RETAIN=1 PUBLISH removes the retained message for a Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: Future subscribers for that topic must receive no retained message until another retained message is established.
requirements.why_checkable: A new matching Subscription can be created after deletion and checked for absence of retained delivery.

requirements.quote: A zero byte retained message MUST NOT be stored as a retained message on the Server.
requirements.condition: When a retained publication has a zero-byte payload
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must leave no zero-byte retained-message record.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not store the zero-byte message as a retained message.
requirements.why_checkable: Retained storage can be inspected or queried through a later Subscription.

requirements.quote: If the RETAIN flag is 0, in a PUBLISH Packet sent by a Client to a Server, the Server MUST NOT store the message and MUST NOT remove or replace any existing retained message.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a Client PUBLISH with RETAIN set to 0
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must leave the publication out of retained-message storage.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not store that publication as a retained message.
requirements.why_checkable: A subsequent matching Subscription can verify that the RETAIN=0 publication was not retained.

requirements.quote: If the RETAIN flag is 0, in a PUBLISH Packet sent by a Client to a Server, the Server MUST NOT store the message and MUST NOT remove or replace any existing retained message.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a Client PUBLISH with RETAIN=0 and an existing retained message has the same Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must preserve the existing retained message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not remove the existing retained message.
requirements.why_checkable: A prior retained value can be queried after the RETAIN=0 publication to confirm it still exists.

requirements.quote: If the RETAIN flag is 0, in a PUBLISH Packet sent by a Client to a Server, the Server MUST NOT store the message and MUST NOT remove or replace any existing retained message.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a Client PUBLISH with RETAIN=0 and an existing retained message has the same Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must leave the existing retained-message value unchanged.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not replace the existing retained message with the RETAIN=0 publication.
requirements.why_checkable: The retained value before and after the publication can be compared for replacement.

requirements.quote: The Topic Name MUST be present as the first field in the PUBLISH Packet Variable header.
requirements.condition: For every PUBLISH Packet variable header
requirements.required_behavior: Topic Name must be present as its first field.
requirements.why_checkable: A PUBLISH variable header can be decoded and its first field identified.

requirements.quote: It MUST be a UTF-8 encoded string.
requirements.condition: For the Topic Name field in a PUBLISH variable header
requirements.required_behavior: Topic Name must use the MQTT UTF-8 encoded-string representation.
requirements.why_checkable: The string length prefix and bytes can be decoded and validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: The Topic Name in the PUBLISH Packet MUST NOT contain wildcard characters.
requirements.condition: For every PUBLISH Topic Name
requirements.required_behavior: The Topic Name must contain no wildcard characters.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Wildcard characters must not occur in the Topic Name.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded Topic Name can be scanned for wildcard characters.

requirements.quote: The Topic Name in a PUBLISH Packet sent by a Server to a subscribing Client MUST match the Subscription’s Topic Filter according to the matching process defined in Section 4.7.
requirements.condition: When the Server sends PUBLISH to a Client because of a Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The PUBLISH Topic Name must match that Subscription's Topic Filter using the Section 4.7 matching process.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not deliver a PUBLISH whose Topic Name fails that matching process.
requirements.why_checkable: Controlled Topic Names and Topic Filters can be evaluated by the referenced matching process and compared with observed delivery.

requirements.quote: The receiver of a PUBLISH Packet MUST respond according to Table 3.4 - Expected Publish Packet response as determined by the QoS in the PUBLISH Packet.
requirements.condition: When a receiver handles a PUBLISH Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The receiver would select the response specified by Table 3.4 for the PUBLISH QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: Table 3.4 is not present in this chunk, so the required response type for each QoS value is not supplied by this evidence.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST deliver the message to the Client respecting the maximum QoS of all the matching subscriptions.
requirements.condition: When an Application Message matches one or more Client Subscriptions
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must deliver the message using a QoS that respects the maximum QoS across all matching Subscriptions.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not deliver above the applicable maximum granted QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: Multiple matching Subscriptions with controlled maximum QoS values can be created and the delivered QoS observed.

requirements.quote: It MUST either make a positive acknowledgement, according to the normal QoS rules, or close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When the Server does not authorize a Client's PUBLISH
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must either send the normal positive QoS acknowledgement or close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not leave the unauthorized PUBLISH unacknowledged while keeping the connection open.
requirements.error_behavior: Acknowledge positively according to QoS, or close the Network Connection.
requirements.why_checkable: An authorization denial can be induced and the acknowledgement/connection outcome observed.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header in the PUBREL Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: For every PUBREL Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header bits 3, 2, 1, and 0 must equal 0, 0, 1, and 0 respectively.
requirements.why_checkable: The PUBREL fixed-header low nibble can be compared with binary 0010.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When PUBREL fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the PUBREL Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Alternate low-nibble values can be injected and malformed handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When PUBREL fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting invalid PUBREL flags.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid PUBREL can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the SUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header bits 3, 2, 1, and 0 must equal 0, 0, 1, and 0 respectively.
requirements.why_checkable: The SUBSCRIBE fixed-header low nibble can be compared with binary 0010.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When SUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Alternate low-nibble values can be injected and malformed handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When SUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting invalid SUBSCRIBE flags.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid SUBSCRIBE can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters in a SUBSCRIBE packet payload MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3.
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter in a SUBSCRIBE payload
requirements.required_behavior: The Topic Filter must use the MQTT UTF-8 encoded-string representation.
requirements.why_checkable: The length prefix and bytes can be decoded and validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: If the Server chooses not to support topic filters that contain wildcard characters it MUST reject any Subscription request whose filter contains them.
requirements.condition: When wildcard Topic Filter support is disabled and a Subscription request contains a wildcard
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must reject the Subscription request.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not accept the unsupported wildcard Subscription.
requirements.why_checkable: With wildcard support disabled, a wildcard filter can be submitted and the result observed.

requirements.quote: The payload of a SUBSCRIBE packet MUST contain at least one Topic Filter / QoS pair.
requirements.condition: For every SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The payload must contain one or more Topic Filter/QoS pairs.
requirements.why_checkable: The pair count can be computed while parsing the payload.

requirements.quote: A SUBSCRIBE packet with no payload is a protocol violation.
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Packet has no payload
requirements.required_behavior: The receiver must classify it as a protocol violation.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat the empty-payload SUBSCRIBE as a protocol violation.
requirements.why_checkable: An empty-payload SUBSCRIBE can be injected and violation handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2.
requirements.condition: When any reserved bit in a SUBSCRIBE payload is nonzero
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Reserved payload bits can be set individually and malformed handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2.
requirements.condition: When any reserved bit in a SUBSCRIBE payload is nonzero
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting the invalid reserved bit.
requirements.why_checkable: A nonzero reserved bit can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2.
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Requested QoS is not 0, 1, or 2
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the SUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Requested QoS value 3 can be injected and malformed handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat a SUBSCRIBE packet as malformed and close the Network Connection if any of Reserved bits in the payload are non-zero, or QoS is not 0,1 or 2.
requirements.condition: When a SUBSCRIBE Requested QoS is not 0, 1, or 2
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting invalid Requested QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: Requested QoS value 3 can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: When the Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet from a Client, the Server MUST respond with a SUBACK Packet.
requirements.condition: When the Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet from a Client
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must respond with SUBACK.
requirements.why_checkable: A SUBSCRIBE can be sent and the response packet type observed.

requirements.quote: The SUBACK Packet MUST have the same Packet Identifier as the SUBSCRIBE Packet that it is acknowledging.
requirements.condition: When SUBACK acknowledges a SUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: SUBACK must contain the same Packet Identifier as SUBSCRIBE.
requirements.why_checkable: The request and response Packet Identifiers can be decoded and compared.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE Packet containing a Topic Filter that is identical to an existing Subscription’s Topic Filter then it MUST completely replace that existing Subscription with a new Subscription.
requirements.condition: When SUBSCRIBE contains a Topic Filter identical to an existing Subscription's Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must completely replace the existing Subscription with a new Subscription.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not retain two separate Subscriptions for the identical Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: Subscription state before and after re-subscribing with the same filter can be compared.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filter in the new Subscription will be identical to that in the previous Subscription, although its maximum QoS value could be different.
requirements.condition: After an existing Subscription is replaced because the same Topic Filter was submitted
requirements.required_behavior: The new Subscription must retain exactly the same Topic Filter.
requirements.why_checkable: The old and new stored Topic Filter values can be compared character-for-character.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filter in the new Subscription will be identical to that in the previous Subscription, although its maximum QoS value could be different.
requirements.condition: When replacing a Subscription with another having the same Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: The new Subscription is permitted to have a different maximum QoS.
requirements.why_checkable: Re-subscription can use a different Requested QoS and the stored maximum QoS observed.

requirements.quote: Any existing retained messages matching the Topic Filter MUST be re-sent, but the flow of publications MUST NOT be interrupted.
requirements.condition: When an existing Subscription is replaced and retained messages match its Topic Filter
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must re-send those retained messages.
requirements.why_checkable: Retained messages can be prepared before re-subscription and their re-delivery observed.

requirements.quote: Any existing retained messages matching the Topic Filter MUST be re-sent, but the flow of publications MUST NOT be interrupted.
requirements.condition: While the Server replaces an existing Subscription and re-sends retained messages
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must maintain the ongoing flow of publications.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not interrupt publication flow because of the replacement.
requirements.why_checkable: Live publications can be sent during re-subscription and monitored for an interruption.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE packet that contains multiple Topic Filters it MUST handle that packet as if it had received a sequence of multiple SUBSCRIBE packets, except that it combines their responses into a single SUBACK response.
requirements.condition: When one SUBSCRIBE Packet contains multiple Topic Filters
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must process the filters as an ordered sequence of individual SUBSCRIBE requests.
requirements.why_checkable: The resulting Subscription state can be compared with processing the same filters in separate requests.

requirements.quote: If a Server receives a SUBSCRIBE packet that contains multiple Topic Filters it MUST handle that packet as if it had received a sequence of multiple SUBSCRIBE packets, except that it combines their responses into a single SUBACK response.
requirements.condition: When one SUBSCRIBE Packet contains multiple Topic Filters
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must combine the per-filter results into one SUBACK response.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not send a separate SUBACK for each Topic Filter in that packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The response packet count can be observed for a multi-filter SUBSCRIBE.

requirements.quote: The SUBACK Packet sent by the Server to the Client MUST contain a return code for each Topic Filter/QoS pair.
requirements.condition: For a SUBACK response to SUBSCRIBE
requirements.required_behavior: SUBACK must contain exactly one return code corresponding to each Topic Filter/QoS pair.
requirements.why_checkable: The number of request pairs and response return codes can be counted and compared.

requirements.quote: This return code MUST either show the maximum QoS that was granted for that Subscription or indicate that the subscription failed.
requirements.condition: For each SUBACK return code
requirements.required_behavior: The code must indicate either the granted maximum QoS or Subscription failure.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: It must not encode an outcome outside those alternatives.
requirements.why_checkable: Each code can be decoded and classified as granted QoS or failure.

requirements.quote: The Server might grant a lower maximum QoS than the subscriber requested.
requirements.condition: When granting a Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to grant a maximum QoS lower than requested.
requirements.why_checkable: The Requested QoS and SUBACK granted QoS can be compared.

requirements.quote: The QoS of Payload Messages sent in response to a Subscription MUST be the minimum of the QoS of the originally published message and the maximum QoS granted by the Server.
requirements.condition: When the Server delivers a Payload Message for a Subscription
requirements.required_behavior: Delivery QoS must equal min(original publication QoS, granted maximum QoS).
requirements.why_checkable: The original QoS, granted maximum, and delivered QoS can be captured and compared arithmetically.

requirements.quote: The server is permitted to send duplicate copies of a message to a subscriber in the case where the original message was published with QoS 1 and the maximum QoS granted was QoS 0.
requirements.condition: When original publication QoS is 1 and granted maximum QoS is 0
requirements.required_behavior: The Server is permitted to send duplicate copies to the subscriber.
requirements.why_checkable: The specified QoS combination can be exercised and duplicate deliveries recognized as permitted.

requirements.quote: The order of return codes in the SUBACK Packet MUST match the order of Topic Filters in the SUBSCRIBE Packet.
requirements.condition: When SUBACK responds to a multi-filter SUBSCRIBE
requirements.required_behavior: SUBACK return codes must appear in the same order as their Topic Filters in SUBSCRIBE.
requirements.why_checkable: Distinct per-filter outcomes can be arranged and response order compared with request order.

requirements.quote: SUBACK return codes other than 0x00, 0x01, 0x02 and 0x80 are reserved and MUST NOT be used.
requirements.condition: For the SUBACK return-code value space
requirements.required_behavior: Only 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, and 0x80 are assigned; all other values must remain reserved.
requirements.why_checkable: Encoder and decoder value tables can be checked against the explicit four-value set.

requirements.quote: SUBACK return codes other than 0x00, 0x01, 0x02 and 0x80 are reserved and MUST NOT be used.
requirements.condition: When the Server encodes a SUBACK return code
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must choose from 0x00, 0x01, 0x02, or 0x80.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not use any other return-code value.
requirements.why_checkable: Every emitted SUBACK code can be checked for membership in the allowed set.

requirements.quote: Bits 3,2,1 and 0 of the fixed header of the UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet are reserved and MUST be set to 0,0,1 and 0 respectively.
requirements.condition: For every UNSUBSCRIBE Control Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Fixed-header bits 3, 2, 1, and 0 must equal 0, 0, 1, and 0 respectively.
requirements.why_checkable: The UNSUBSCRIBE fixed-header low nibble can be compared with binary 0010.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When UNSUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must classify the UNSUBSCRIBE Packet as malformed.
requirements.why_checkable: Alternate low-nibble values can be injected and malformed handling observed.

requirements.quote: The Server MUST treat any other value as malformed and close the Network Connection.
requirements.condition: When UNSUBSCRIBE fixed-header bits 3 through 0 are not 0010
requirements.required_behavior: The Server must close the Network Connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The Server must not continue after detecting invalid UNSUBSCRIBE flags.
requirements.why_checkable: An invalid UNSUBSCRIBE can be injected and transport closure observed.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3, packed contiguously.
requirements.condition: For every Topic Filter in an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: The Topic Filter must use the MQTT UTF-8 encoded-string representation.
requirements.why_checkable: Each filter's length prefix and bytes can be decoded and validated as UTF-8.

requirements.quote: The Topic Filters in an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST be UTF-8 encoded strings as defined in Section 1.5.3, packed contiguously.
requirements.condition: When an UNSUBSCRIBE Packet contains multiple Topic Filters
requirements.required_behavior: The encoded Topic Filter strings must be packed contiguously without intervening data or padding.
requirements.why_checkable: The end offset of each decoded string can be compared with the start offset of the next.

requirements.quote: The Payload of an UNSUBSCRIBE packet MUST contain at least one Topic Filter.
requirements.condition: For every UNSUBSCRIBE Packet
requirements.required_behavior: Its Payload must contain one or more Topic Filters.
requirements.why_checkable: The decoded Topic Filter count can be checked to be at least one.
